definitions.train_full_nll: original CE sum / answer token count while weights update
definitions.validation_full_nll: original CE sum / answer token count at fixed epoch-end weights; sole checkpoint criterion
definitions.C1_original: mean over 152 rows of (off row mean NLL - correct row mean NLL)
definitions.C1_category: mean over rows of (off class loss_sum - correct class loss_sum)/row full-answer token count
definitions.pooled_category_mean: sum class losses / sum class tokens; different denominator from row-average C1
definitions.reader_norm: L2 per-token RMS across active prompt and answer positions; train aggregates varying weights, validation uses fixed weights
definitions.epoch_gate: end-of-epoch parameter; cannot multiply it by time-aggregated train raw norm to reconstruct gated norm
definitions.C1_numerical_residual: original transpose CE and diagnostic flatten CE path difference retained; no category correction or exact causal attribution of numerical discrepancy

literature_sources.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
literature_sources.local_version: 原论文PDF，具体页码依本地文件
author_fact: Perceiver Resampler将变长视觉特征变成64个latent。
新增跨注意力／dense残差使用零初始化tanh门控，初始模型等同冻结LM。
Table3分别报告门控、resampler、插层频率消融；不同频率的参数与时耗不同。
project_hypothesis: 当前无门控内部delta可能扰动冻结Qwen隐藏分布。
固定瓶颈可能改善计算与优化；是否对pKD有效需要对照。
proposed_control: 共同K,d,dtype；记录源读取和消息重用次数。
固定插层，对比zero gate、nonzero gate、无gate，匹配活跃参数和更新。
non_equivalent_components: 原视觉输入／Chinchilla／海量混合语料与当前蛋白-条件pKD任务不同。
多层原设计不能直接解释单层内部连接器优势。
preregister_endpoint: 冻结pKD MAE与全样本有效率；配对种子差。
训练/验证NLL、梯度、delta/hidden范数比和gate轨迹仅作机制端点。
